# Best Microsoft Power Platform consultants in Canberra

For a Canberra organisation looking for Microsoft Power Platform expertise, I’d start with a shortlist that combines **local delivery experience, Microsoft technology specialisation, government-sector capability and evidence of practical implementation work**\.

The right consultant depends on whether you need Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Dataverse, enterprise governance, or a secure solution for a federal government environment. I found several Canberra-based specialists worth considering, plus a Microsoft-focused provider with a broader delivery model.

These are a research-based shortlist, not a definitive ranking. I’ve prioritised evidence of relevant services and local presence rather than relying on star ratings alone.

## Recommended shortlist

![Managed IT Canberra | Managed IT Support Services | OPC](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hF2FVDeT9V3J30lBB6QFUBKW0AzvPMV2dr_dHOWSWPiC0MJ1kOykgUFz0bUcUTvayx92V8Q5Pnx3TetjjN_44nUWbBMzXTvRDLiEwUhPLQleBdg1zts-omhdcMrhsySTqk40w_a9MNKkJaGajVVsaarbLL953gQ0pBRHLX3H3Jofg076AEK_NC05BRFmwC1Y?purpose=fullsize)

## 1\. ObjectPoint

Best fit: federal government applications and case management

ObjectPoint is based in Canberra and explicitly focuses on Power Platform and Dataverse for federal departments and government suppliers. Its published solution areas include medical review, welfare management and contingent workforce management, alongside consulting and ongoing support. [www.objectpoint.com.au](https://www.objectpoint.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Why consider them\:** Their focus is closely aligned with structured business applications, case workflows, document handling, audit-ready reporting and government delivery requirements.

**Website\:** [objectpoint.com.au](https://www.objectpoint.com.au/)

---



## 2\. Mojo Up

Best fit: security-conscious government environments

Mojo Up is a Canberra-born Microsoft consultancy established in 2024. Its published services include Power Platform business applications and automation, Microsoft 365, Azure, cybersecurity and specialist resource augmentation. It also emphasises knowledge transfer and sustainable solutions. [www.mojoup.com.au](https://www.mojoup.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Why consider them\:** Particularly relevant if you need consultants familiar with government security requirements, internal capability uplift and integration with an existing ICT team.

**Website\:** [mojoup.com.au](https://www.mojoup.com.au/)

---

## 3\. Office Experts Group

Best fit: Power Apps, Power Automate and legacy-system modernisation

Office Experts Group has consultants serving Canberra and says it has operated since 2000. Its Power Platform services cover workflow automation, Power BI reporting and Power Apps, alongside Microsoft 365, Access database remediation and custom integrations. It offers remote delivery and local on-site support. **Why consider them\:** A practical option when you need to replace spreadsheet-driven processes, modernise older Access databases or connect existing Microsoft systems without losing maintainability.

**Website\:** [officeexperts.com.au/microsoft-consultants-canberra](https://www.officeexperts.com.au/microsoft-consultants-canberra)

## 4\. Cosmic Tech Solutions

Best fit: cleared consultants and complex technical delivery

Cosmic Tech describes itself as a Canberra-based specialist in Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Azure and related data services. Its published capabilities include security-cleared professionals, solution implementation, role-based access controls and application lifecycle management. [www.cosmictech.com.au](https://www.cosmictech.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Why consider them\:** Worth approaching if your project requires a combination of Power Platform development, Dynamics integration and security-cleared technical resources.

**Website\:** [cosmictech.com.au](https://www.cosmictech.com.au/)

## 5\. Teratek Digital

Best fit: Power Platform integrated with Dynamics 365 and Azure

Teratek identifies Power Platform, Power Apps, Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365 and Azure as core capabilities. It positions its services around secure, scalable solutions for government and regulated environments. [teratek.com.au](https://teratek.com.au/about-us/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Why consider them\:** A candidate for projects where low-code apps and automation need to fit into a wider Microsoft business application or cloud architecture.

**Website\:** [teratek.com.au](https://www.teratek.com.au/)

## Which should you approach first?

| If your main requirement is… | Start with |
|--------|--------|
| Government case management and Dataverse | ObjectPoint |
| Security-conscious federal government delivery | Mojo Up |
| Power Automate, reporting and legacy-system modernisation | Office Experts Group |
| Cleared technical resources and Dynamics integration | Cosmic Tech Solutions |
| Power Platform within a wider Microsoft architecture | Teratek Digital |


These are use-case matches based on published service descriptions, not independently verified performance rankings. The public information I reviewed does not establish that all five hold Microsoft's current **Low Code Application Development specialisation**\. Microsoft provides a [partner directory](https://www.microsoft.com/en-au/power-platform/products/power-apps/partners) where you can check specialisations and solution designations. [www.microsoft.com](https://www.microsoft.com/en-au/power-platform/products/power-apps/partners?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## How to verify that a consultant is reputable

Before selecting a partner, I would ask each shortlisted firm for\:

- **Two comparable client references** — ideally Canberra or Australian public-sector projects, if relevant.
- **A live demonstration** of a production Power App or Power Automate solution, with client-sensitive details removed.
- **Named delivery personnel** — including the solution architect and the people who will actually build the solution.
- **Governance and security practices** — Dataverse design, environment strategy, data-loss prevention policies, access controls, deployment pipelines and monitoring.
- **A clear handover plan** — documentation, source solution ownership, training, support arrangements and ongoing licensing costs.
- **Relevant Microsoft credentials** — current partner specialisations and individual certifications, verified rather than simply asserted.
